final_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.NCESSchool,
       frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS s 
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds 
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = '9' 
  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T3.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T3.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Admin1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Admin2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' 
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School AS SchoolName,
           sc.Virtual AS Virtual,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, t.sname
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT sch.Phone, sch.Ext
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = '0'
  AND T1.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] < 0.18;

SELECT School,
       City,
       AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = '1'
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(StatusType)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND (SOCType = 'District Community Day School' OR DOCType = 'District Community Day School');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.EdOpsName LIKE '%Youth Authority School%';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`, schools.School AS `School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.Latitude, T2.`School Type`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT Fname, District
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
)
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
  AND Fname IN (
      SELECT Fname
      FROM (
          SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      )
      GROUP BY Fname
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 2
  );

SELECT f."District Code",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmLName1 AS "Administrator Last Name",
       District,
       County,
       School
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum = '40';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmEmail3
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.DOC = 54
  AND T2.SOC = 62
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age > 65 AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE comments.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments)

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'not well-finished'
           ELSE 'well-finished'
       END AS status
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Id = (
    SELECT c.PostId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId = 23853
      AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
);

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 65041;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

SELECT COUNT(v.Id) AS NumberOfVotes
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'DatEpicCoderGuyWhoPrograms';
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = '24') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = '24') AS posts_to_votes_ratio;
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'SilentGhost';

SELECT c.Text

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT (balance_end.b - balance_start.b) * 100.0 / balance_start.b AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, per segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest consumption per segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of lowest-consumption customers / their count
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_annual_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN segment_min AS s
      ON z.Segment = s.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = s.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    / SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Price = 634.8
      AND Date LIKE '2012-08-25%'
);

);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P 
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M 
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,  M.home_player_5,
        M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,  M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10,
        M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match m
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
          m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
          m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
          m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,

          m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11

) s ON s.country_id = c.id

SELECT T.team_long_name

WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height)
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
WHERE M.country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy');

SELECT player_name
FROM Player

LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players

  AND birthday > '1990';

WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'

ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes

      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  );

SELECT

FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name

SELECT

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration

SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games

);

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve

SELECT L.name
FROM League L

ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id

SELECT P.player_name

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

    WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'

FROM district;

JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id

    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'

);

SELECT 
    (T2.balance - T1.balance) * 100.0 / T1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND T2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND T1.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
          AND status = 'C'          -- approved loan (contract running, OK)
        ORDER BY loan_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount)) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_running_ok
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT 
    account.account_id,
    district.A2 AS district_name,
    district.A3 AS district_region
FROM account

WHERE strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1993'

FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

    d.A2 AS district,

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'

JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id

             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'More in-patients'
        ELSE 'More outpatients'

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase;

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount,
       l.payments,
       l.duration,
       l.status,
       CASE
         WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'finished, no problems'
         WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'finished, loan not paid'
         WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'running, payments OK so far'
         WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'running, client in debt'
       END AS payment_status
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = 1 AND gender_id = 2;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(T2.id = 7) - SUM(T2.id = 1) AS difference
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM attribute a
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis, Laboratory.Date
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND (L.TP < 6.0 OR L.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(P.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT AVG(T1."aCL IgG")
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT T2.Date, (STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  /
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30');

SELECT strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age, E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = E.ID
ORDER BY L.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND Date = '1995-09-04' AND "T-CHO" < 250;
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY `First Date` LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4' AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1995'

WHERE T1.ID IN (

      AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
);

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND strftime('%Y', Description) >= '1997' AND strftime('%Y', Description) < '1998';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND Laboratory.GPT > 30
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 4;
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`Birthday`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT AVG(T1.ALB) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.PLT > 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(e.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298 AND p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT (l.UA > 8.0 AND p.SEX = 'M') OR (l.UA > 6.5 AND p.SEX = 'F') AS within_normal_range
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 57266;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994' AND T2.GOT < 60

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.GPT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT Patient.ID, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN (SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) M
  ON L.ID = M.ID AND L.Date = M.MaxDate
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5);

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
INNER JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);
SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.TG >= 200
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-' AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS AGE
FROM PATIENT
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM LABORATORY
    WHERE HCT >= 52
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(ID) > 2
);
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29;

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50 AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)

FROM Patient AS T1

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80 AND Laboratory.IGA < 500 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE t.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        pct_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_increase DESC) AS r_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_increase ASC) AS r_asc
    FROM seg_pct
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM ranked
WHERE r_desc = 1 OR r_asc = 1
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT

    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c

JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      AND status IN ('A', 'C')          -- approved / running OK loans
    ORDER BY loan_id                    -- the first (earliest) approved loan on 1993/7/5
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC            -- end-of-day balance on that date
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_account ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC            -- end-of-day balance on that date
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0 / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total,
               MIN(total) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_total
        FROM totals
    ) t
    WHERE t.total = t.min_total
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct
    FROM seg
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS type, Segment, pct FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MAX(pct) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS type, Segment, pct FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MIN(pct) FROM pct);

WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

SELECT T4.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client T1
JOIN district T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN account T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T2.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)

LIMIT 1;

WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)

SELECT (t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t1.account_id = (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM loan
      WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      ORDER BY loan_id
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

WITH consumption_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_change
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT MAX(pct_change) AS max_pct,
           MIN(pct_change) AS min_pct
    FROM consumption_pct
)
SELECT
    top.Segment    AS biggest_segment,
    top.pct_change AS biggest_percentage_increase,
    low.Segment    AS lowest_segment,
    low.pct_change AS lowest_percentage_increase
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN consumption_pct AS top ON top.pct_change = e.max_pct
JOIN consumption_pct AS low ON low.pct_change = e.min_pct;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage_of_EUR_customers
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c 
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) 
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Price = 634.8
      AND Date = '2012-08-25'
);

SELECT
    t.GasStationID,
    SUM(t.Price) AS Revenue
FROM transactions_1k t
GROUP BY t.GasStationID
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK';

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
GROUP BY g.Country
ORDER BY MAX(t.Price / t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Consumption
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.ProductID = 5
  AND T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00
  AND T2.Date = '201208';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE overall_rating >= 60
  AND overall_rating < 65
  AND defensive_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(penalties) AS max_penalties
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.max_penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal - M.home_team_goal > 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    T1.player_name,
    (DATETIME() - T1.birthday) AS age
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) >= '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) <= '2015';

    L.name AS league_name, 
    COUNT(M.league_id) AS total_matches
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id

FROM Player
WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00'

FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'

        SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
          AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PA.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
       / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_footed
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
  ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT SUM(TA2.chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(TA2.id)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'

FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT
    (
        (SELECT overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes
         WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id
                                FROM Player
                                WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk')
         ORDER BY date DESC
         LIMIT 1)
        -
        (SELECT overall_rating
         FROM Player_Attributes
         WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id
                                FROM Player
                                WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
         ORDER BY date DESC
         LIMIT 1)
    ) * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes
     WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id
                            FROM Player
                            WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')
     ORDER BY date DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS percentage_higher;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p 
    ON p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,
        m.home_player_4,  m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,
        m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,  m.home_player_9,
        m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11
      );

SELECT SUM(M.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match M
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player P
    WHERE P.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira')
      AND P.player_api_id IN (
            M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,
            M.away_player_4,  M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,
            M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,
            M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
      )
);

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM Match AS M
WHERE M.home_player_1 IN (
        SELECT P.player_api_id
        FROM Player AS P
        WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(P.birthday))) < 31
      )
   OR M.home_player_2 IN (
        SELECT P.player_api_id
        FROM Player AS P
        WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(P.birthday))) < 31
      )
   OR M.home_player_3 IN (
        SELECT P.player_api_id
        FROM Player AS P
        WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(P.birthday))) < 31
      )
   OR M.home_player_4 IN (
        SELECT P.player_api_id
        FROM Player AS P

             M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,

WITH country_avg AS (
    SELECT
        C.name AS country,
        AVG(P.weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM Country C
    JOIN Match M
      ON M.country_id = C.id
    JOIN Player P
      ON P.player_api_id IN (
            M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
            M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
            M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
            M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
            M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
            M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
         )
    GROUP BY C.name
)
SELECT country
FROM country_avg
WHERE avg_weight = (SELECT MAX(avg_weight) FROM country_avg);

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT (t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance AS balance_increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t1 
    ON t1.account_id = l.account_id
   AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'      -- balance at date B
JOIN trans t2 
    ON t2.account_id = l.account_id
   AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'      -- balance at date A
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
  AND l.status = 'A'               -- approved loan
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC             -- first approved loan on that date
LIMIT 1;

    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage

JOIN district d

WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS holders_without_card
