WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_tot AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_tot m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, total * 1.0 / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH cons AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (total2013 - total2012) * 100.0 / total2013 AS Percentage
  FROM cons
),
mx AS (
  SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1
),
mn AS (
  SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'Biggest' AS Type, Segment, Percentage FROM mx
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lowest', Segment, Percentage FROM mn;

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(c.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS annual_average_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 AS c
    JOIN lowest_per_segment AS l
      ON l.Segment = c.Segment AND c.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Difference_KAM_SME;

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM cons
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase AS PercentageIncrease
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_increase AS PercentageIncrease
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct);

JOIN Team AS T ON T_At.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND T_At.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT (l.overall_rating - j.overall_rating) * 100.0 / l.overall_rating
FROM
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') l,
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') j;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(birthday))) > 34

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11)
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Daan Smith' OR p.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id WHERE CAST((julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T2.birthday))) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) <= 30
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.finishing = 1 GROUP BY T1.player_name ORDER BY MAX(strftime('%s', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%s', T1.birthday)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT Country.name
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) AS mp
JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
JOIN Country ON Country.id = mp.country_id
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH im AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
pids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM im
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN pids ON p.player_api_id = pids.pid;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';
SELECT DISTINCT buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);
SELECT L.name FROM League AS L JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(P.id) FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - dt.A11 AS gap
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dt2.A11)
                FROM client c2
                JOIN district dt2 ON c2.district_id = dt2.district_id
                WHERE c2.gender = 'F')

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Owner' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T2.status = 'C'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

LIMIT 1

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12

      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12

        AND a2.date LIKE '93%'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date)
              FROM trans
              WHERE date LIKE '95%' OR date LIKE '1995%');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;
SELECT T1.client_id FROM client AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id WHERE T3.issued = '1994-03-03'
SELECT account.date FROM account JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT T1.district_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.date = '1994-08-25' AND T2.status = 'A'

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';
SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount = 5100 AND date = '1998-09-02')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND (account.date LIKE '1996%' OR account.date LIKE '96%');

SELECT district.A2 FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';
SELECT account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status IN ('A', 'C')
  ORDER BY loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    AND date = '1993-03-22'
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    AND date = '1998-12-27'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0 / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';
SELECT d.A2, d.A3 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = '4990'

SELECT loan.account_id, district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT T3.A2, SUM(T1.amount) FROM trans AS T1 JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.type = 'VYDAJ' AND T1.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY T3.A2 ORDER BY SUM(T1.amount) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.client_id NOT IN (
      SELECT dp2.client_id
      FROM card cd
      JOIN disp dp2 ON cd.disp_id = dp2.disp_id
  )

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';
SELECT A3, A2 FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '950101' AND '971231'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CAST(A15 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date LIKE '97%';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold'

FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021';

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id
FROM client cl
JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND di.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND dp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(d.A15)
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (

         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)

         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(c.Currency)) = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgCons AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annualAvg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgCons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT TRIM(c.Segment) AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(c.Currency)) LIKE '%EUR%'
    AND UPPER(TRIM(c.Segment)) IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY TRIM(c.Segment)
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cons2013, 0) AS pct_increase
  FROM seg
  WHERE cons2013 > 0
),
hi AS (
  SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC, Segment ASC LIMIT 1
),
lo AS (
  SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC, Segment ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM hi
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM lo;

WITH match_player_country AS (

    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_6, country_id FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_10, country_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11, country_id FROM Match
)

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match

    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_late AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
)

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT ym, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN date LIKE '____-__%' THEN substr(date, 1, 4) || substr(date, 6, 2)
                WHEN length(date) = 6 THEN '20' || substr(date, 1, 4)
                WHEN length(date) = 8 AND date NOT LIKE '%-%' THEN substr(date, 1, 6)
                ELSE strftime('%Y%m', date)
            END AS ym,
            amount
        FROM trans
        WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
    ) n
    WHERE n.ym LIKE '2021%'
    GROUP BY n.ym
) m;

        THEN substr(TRIM(CAST(issued AS TEXT)), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(TRIM(CAST(issued AS TEXT)), 5, 2) || '-' || substr(TRIM(CAST(issued AS TEXT)), 7, 2)

SELECT

   - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0

FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.loan_id, l.amount,
    CASE
      WHEN length(CAST(l.date AS TEXT)) = 6 THEN '19' || substr(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2)
      WHEN substr(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 3, 1) = '-' THEN '19' || substr(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 2)
      ELSE substr(CAST(l.date AS TEXT), 1, 4)
    END AS yr
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
) t
WHERE yr IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT

    l.payments AS monthly_payment,

        WHEN 'A' THEN 'contract finished - no problems, loan fully repaid'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'contract finished - loan NOT paid, client still owes the full amount'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'contract running - client in debt, payments behind'
        ELSE 'no loan on record for this client'
    END AS payment_status
FROM (SELECT 992 AS target_client_id) t
LEFT JOIN client c
       ON CAST(c.client_id AS INTEGER) = t.target_client_id
LEFT JOIN disp d

INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE TRIM(T1.Admission) = '+'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Description LIKE '%1997%' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis IN ('1', 1)
  AND (strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") = '1997' OR CAST(e."Examination Date" AS TEXT) LIKE '1997%')
  AND UPPER(CAST(p.SEX AS TEXT)) = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.TG AS REAL) >= 200

SELECT T2.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON CAST(T1.ID AS INTEGER) = CAST(T2.ID AS INTEGER)
WHERE T1.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Birthday)
    FROM Patient AS T3
    WHERE CAST(T3.ID AS INTEGER) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS INTEGER) FROM Examination)
)

SELECT COUNT(L.ID) / 12.0
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE TRIM(UPPER(P.SEX)) = 'M'
  AND CAST(L.Date AS TEXT) LIKE '1998%'

SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC, T1.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M'
             AND l.UA IS NOT NULL
             AND UPPER(TRIM(CAST(l.UA AS TEXT))) NOT IN ('', 'NULL')
             AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F'
                    AND l.UA IS NOT NULL
                    AND UPPER(TRIM(CAST(l.UA AS TEXT))) NOT IN ('', 'NULL')
                    AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient P
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E.ID = P.ID
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 1
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE TRIM(UPPER(T1.SEX)) = 'M' AND T2."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(T2."T-BIL") <> '' AND CAST(T2."T-BIL" AS REAL) >= 2.0

FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = E.ID AND L.Date = E."Examination Date"

SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND DATE("Examination Date") = '1996-12-02'
SELECT CASE WHEN "T-CHO" < 250 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND "Date" = '1995-09-04'
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE LOWER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%aortitis%' ORDER BY "First Date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'
SELECT strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE date(T2."Examination Date") = '1997-01-27' AND TRIM(T2.Diagnosis) = 'SLE'

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959/3/1'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-12%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory l
INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday LIKE '1959-02-18%';

FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
      AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT <> ''
      AND ALB IS NOT NULL AND ALB <> ''

)
SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients, GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

      SELECT AVG(T3.`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(T3.`aCL IgM`) + AVG(T3.`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" > 0 AND "U-PRO" < 30;
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P

  AND L."T-BIL" NOT IN ('', 'NULL', 'null')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE TRIM(CAST(ID AS TEXT)) = '48473'

SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND CAST(GOT AS REAL) >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(T1.SEX)) = 'M'

SELECT AVG(CAST(LDH AS REAL)) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(LDH) NOT IN ('---', '') AND CAST(LDH AS REAL) < 500

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age

INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE TRIM(T2.ALP) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(T2.ALP) <> '' AND CAST(TRIM(T2.ALP) AS REAL) < 300

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE date(T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP IS NOT NULL

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(T2.TP AS REAL) - 8.5 AS deviation FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(T2.TP AS REAL) > 8.5

FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'

       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS albumin_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE substr(CAST(p.Birthday AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '1982'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(Patient.SEX) = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.UA IS NOT NULL AND Laboratory.UA <> '' AND ((UPPER(Patient.SEX) = 'F' AND CAST(Laboratory.UA AS REAL) > 6.5) OR (UPPER(Patient.SEX) = 'M' AND CAST(Laboratory.UA AS REAL) > 8.0))

SELECT AVG(CAST(T2.UA AS REAL))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(T2.UA) <> ''
  AND T2.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%'
  AND Laboratory.UN IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(CAST(Laboratory.UN AS TEXT)) <> ''
  AND Laboratory.UN NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(T1.SEX)) = 'M'
  AND CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN Patient.ID END) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN Patient.ID END) THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END FROM Patient WHERE Patient.ID IN (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5)

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l."T-BIL" AS REAL) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("T-BIL" AS REAL)) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(TRIM(L."T-BIL") AS REAL) >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

WITH numeric_lab AS (
    SELECT L.ID,
           CAST(L."T-CHO" AS REAL) AS tcho
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(CAST(L."T-CHO" AS TEXT)) <> ''
),
max_cho AS (
    SELECT MAX(tcho) AS max_tcho FROM numeric_lab
)
SELECT n.ID,
       n.tcho AS "T-CHO"
FROM numeric_lab n
JOIN Patient P
  ON CAST(P.ID AS TEXT) = CAST(n.ID AS TEXT)
JOIN max_cho m
  ON n.tcho = m.max_tcho
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(age) * 1.0 / COUNT(age) AS average_age
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Patient.ID,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
    FROM Patient
    INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Patient.SEX)) = 'M'
      AND CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(Laboratory."T-CHO" AS TEXT)), '') AS REAL) >= 250
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE CAST(L.TG AS REAL) >= 200 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

  AND T2.CPK != ''

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX,
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(NULLIF(L.GLU, '') AS REAL) >= 180

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P

WHERE L.WBC IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.Admission

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND TRIM(CAST(T2.RBC AS TEXT)) NOT IN ('', '---')

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND CAST(T2.HGB AS REAL) < 10

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND CAST(T2.HGB AS REAL) > 10 AND CAST(T2.HGB AS REAL) < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) >= 2
SELECT AVG(CAST(HCT AS REAL)) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(HCT AS REAL) < 29

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(L.PT AS REAL) >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 30

JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.IGA AS REAL) BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY CAST(L.IGA AS REAL) DESC

JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncreaseSegment,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncreaseSegment

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS seg, ym.Consumption AS cons
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
minc AS (
  SELECT seg, MIN(cons) AS min_cons
  FROM base
  GROUP BY seg
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT b.seg, SUM(b.cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM base b
  JOIN minc m ON m.seg = b.seg AND b.cons = m.min_cons
  GROUP BY b.seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Segment,
    (SELECT Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest_Percentage,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Segment,
    (SELECT Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest_Percentage;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Pct
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Pct
FROM pct
WHERE Pct = (SELECT MAX(Pct) FROM pct)
   OR Pct = (SELECT MIN(Pct) FROM pct);

    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (

      AND date = '1998-12-27'

)

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_avg;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        sum_2012,
        sum_2013,
        (sum_2013 - sum_2012) AS increase,
        ROUND((sum_2013 - sum_2012) * 100.0 / sum_2013, 2) AS pct_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, sum_2012, sum_2013, increase, pct_increase
FROM calc
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM calc)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM calc)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

SELECT (bal_a - bal_b) * 100.0 / bal_b AS increase_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) AS bal_a,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS bal_b
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
        ORDER BY loan_id
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
    AND t.trans_id = (
        SELECT MAX(t2.trans_id)
        FROM trans t2
        WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id
          AND t2.date = t.date
    )
) sub

      SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id

        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Finished - loan was NOT paid off (debt remains)'

JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT T3.attribute_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
ORDER BY height_cm DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN alignment.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg < 100
  AND colour.colour = 'brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
LEFT JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT DISTINCT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
INNER JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis, Laboratory.Date
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = '30609'
ORDER BY Laboratory.Date;

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e."Examination Date", e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) = 1937
  AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Laboratory.TP < 6.0 OR Laboratory.TP > 8.5 THEN Patient.ID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'

SELECT MIN(YEAR(`First Date`) - YEAR(`Birthday`)) AS age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT MAX(YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) - MIN(YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(Birthday)
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) / 12 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT MIN(L.`Date`) AS Lab_Date,
       YEAR(P.`First Date`) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday)
                    FROM Patient
                    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS');

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE SUBTRACT(year(`Examination Date`), year(`First Date`)) >= 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE YEAR(T2.Birthday) < 18 AND YEAR(T1.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND CAST(l."T-BIL" AS REAL) >= 2.0;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.ID IN (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);

SELECT year(`Examination Date`) - year(Birthday) AS Age, Examination.Diagnosis
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
ORDER BY Laboratory.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY Admission ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT YEAR(T1.Date) - YEAR(T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.Date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND T2.Date < '1996-01-01';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday IN ('1959/03/01', '1959-03-01', '1959/3/1', '1959-3-1')
  AND T2.`Examination Date` IN ('1993/09/27', '1993-09-27', '1993/9/27', '1993-9-27');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN l.`T-CHO` END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND T2."Examination Date" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND T2."Examination Date" < '1998-01-01'
ORDER BY T1.ID;

SELECT ID
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4
GROUP BY ID
ORDER BY ID;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964 AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND Laboratory."T-BIL" < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2."ANA Pattern" != 'P' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(T1.ALB) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.PLT > 400 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE YEAR(Date) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET DISEASE'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."Examination Date") BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(E.`Examination Date`), P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE L.ID = 57266
      AND ((L.UA > 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M') OR (L.UA > 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F'))
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS within_normal_range;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60 ORDER BY Date

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE YEAR(Laboratory.Date) = 1994
  AND Laboratory.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH IS NOT NULL AND LDH < 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, YEAR(current_timestamp) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT T2.Admission, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ALP < 300
GROUP BY T2.Admission;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0
ORDER BY Patient.ID;

SELECT P.ID, L.Date, L.TP, (L.TP - 8.5) AS TP_deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5
ORDER BY TP_deviation DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.Date, T2.ALB,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'
ORDER BY T1.ID, T2.Date;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN P.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory AS L2
    WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
)
AND (
    (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN P.ID END) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN P.ID END) AS answer
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT l.`T-BIL`, p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX
ORDER BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY CAST(T1."T-CHO" AS REAL) DESC, T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) / COUNT(Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300
ORDER BY Patient.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE YEAR(Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU >= 180 AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.GLU
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU < 180
  AND YEAR(Patient.Description) = 1991
ORDER BY Patient.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(T1.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10
ORDER BY T1.ID;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.ID = P.ID
      AND L.HGB > 10
      AND L.HGB < 17
  )
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY L.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA > 80
  AND L.IGA < 500
  AND YEAR(P.`First Date`) >= 1990;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
WHERE (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(p.Birthday)) < 70
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CRE >= 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE YEAR(T1.Birthday) >= 1985
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RF < 20 AND T2.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.C3 > 35 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
ORDER BY T1.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
