            WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY b.bond_id;

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element
ORDER BY tally DESC;

SELECT m.label, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ratio
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'tr151'
  AND molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element IN ('cl', 'br', 'i', 'pb');
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50
ORDER BY a.molecule_id, a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'h' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT atom_id, element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR186'
ORDER BY atom_id;

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
UNION
SELECT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
  m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
ORDER BY b.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id)
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(bond.bond_type)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_double_bond_molecules,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_double_bond_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 's'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END), 0) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS num_elements
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a2.element AS element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
) t;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (connected.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1')
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS a1
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '-') * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
  AND bond.molecule_id = 'TR024'
ORDER BY atom.element;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      AND a1.element = 'h'
      AND a2.element = 'h'
) t
JOIN molecule m ON t.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = 'TR008' AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected
  ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
  OR atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
JOIN bond
  ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT T2.atom_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR012' AND T1.bond_type = ' = ' AND T3.element = 'c'

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Alameda';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Phone FROM schools WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND `Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded') AND OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F';
SELECT School FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 1 AND CDSCode IN (SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 500)
SELECT schools.Phone FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT T3.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
JOIN frpm AS T3 ON T3.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT frpm.CDSCode FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` + frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 / sa.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.School, s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda' AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite ASC;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND sc.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
WHERE schools."County" = 'Amador'
  AND frpm."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND frpm."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' AND NumTstTakr = (SELECT MAX(NumTstTakr) FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa');

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND t.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sat.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT School, Street, City, State, Zip
FROM schools
WHERE EILName = 'High School'
  AND CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `County Name` = 'Monterey'
      AND `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  );

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite, T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991' OR STRFTIME('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;
SELECT CAST(`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE SOC = 66) ORDER BY `FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 / sc.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND t.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT T2.School, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T2.County ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM schools AS T2
    JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds

) AS ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
SELECT T2.EILName FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, T2.County
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DOC = 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DOC = 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM schools AS T2
INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Orange'

SELECT s.School, s.ClosedDate
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_closed
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY num_closed DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON s.County = t.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed';

SELECT s.MailStreet, st.sname
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;
SELECT T1.MailStreet, T1.School FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip

WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;
SELECT Phone, Ext, School FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.Charter = 1 AND T1.City = 'Hickman' AND T1.DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' AND schools.Charter = 0 AND (frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) < 0.18

SELECT School, City, AdmFName1, AdmLName1, AdmFName2, AdmLName2, AdmFName3, AdmLName3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1 AND CharterNum = '00D2'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Hickman' AND frpm.`Charter School Number` = '00D4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minyearly AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, y.total_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN minyearly m ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,

    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status IN ('A', 'C')

WITH cust_total AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_total AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_total AS ct
    JOIN min_total AS mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME_LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM_KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM_SME";

WITH rates AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM rates ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM rates ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1)

JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_long_name, MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT League.name
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY SUM(Match.home_team_goal = Match.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) AS INTEGER) AS current_age
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015;

SELECT L.name AS league_name, COUNT(M.match_api_id) AS total_matches
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY total_matches DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(height) / COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00' AND birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00'

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010');
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT l.name AS league_name, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(pa.long_shots) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
GROUP BY T1.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(T2.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT SUM(chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(id)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

SELECT CAST((SELECT overall_rating
             FROM Player_Attributes pa
             JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
             WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
             ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1) -
            (SELECT overall_rating
             FROM Player_Attributes pa
             JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
             WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
             ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1) AS REAL) * 100 /
       (SELECT overall_rating
        FROM Player_Attributes pa
        JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
        WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
        ORDER BY pa.date DESC LIMIT 1) AS percentage_higher;

WITH d AS (
    SELECT PA.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes PA
    JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
      AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
),
b AS (
    SELECT PA.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes PA
    JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
    WHERE P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
      AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
)
SELECT (d.overall_rating - b.overall_rating) * 100.0 / d.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM d, b;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE (datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - datetime(birthday)) > 34

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, a.element

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Minimum total consumption within each segment
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    -- Customers whose consumption equals the segment's minimum
    SELECT 
        ct.Segment, 
        ct.total_consumption
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm 
        ON  ct.Segment = sm.Segment
        AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT 
        Segment, 
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH oldest_female_clients AS (
    -- Step 1: female clients with the earliest birth_date (= oldest)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (
            SELECT MIN(birth_date)
            FROM client
            WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
),
lowest_salary AS (
    -- Step 2: among those oldest females, the lowest average salary (A11) of their districts
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_salary
    FROM oldest_female_clients c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
)
-- Step 3: their account numbers + gap vs. the highest average salary overall
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary) AS gap
FROM oldest_female_clients c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT min_salary FROM lowest_salary);

SELECT

    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished - loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'running - client in DEBT'
    END AS payment_status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 0
        WHEN 'B' THEN l.amount
        ELSE l.amount - l.payments * CAST((julianday('1999-01-01') - julianday(l.date)) / 30.44 AS INT)

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger among male patients
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common,
    -- Deviation in percentage: (male in-patients / male outpatients) * 100
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Description,
    P.`First Date`,
    P.Admission,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS 'Albumin Within Normal Range'
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN P.ID END) 
        / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS percentage_female_abnormal_UA
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p 
    ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest 
    ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.MaxDate
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    Patient.SEX, 
    Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday
FROM 
    Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    L."T-BIL" = (
        SELECT MAX("T-BIL") 
        FROM Laboratory
    );

SELECT 
    P.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT P.ID,
       L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (
        SELECT MAX("T-CHO")
        FROM Laboratory
      )
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(
           CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
           - CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
       ) / COUNT(ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND `T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.TG AS REAL) >= 200
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5
   OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Diagnosis, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (CAST(L.RBC AS REAL) <= 3.5 OR CAST(L.RBC AS REAL) >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comparison_difference
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND CAST(L.PLT AS REAL) BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory 
    ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND Laboratory.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000
    
    INTERSECT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT ID 
    FROM Examination 
    WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY L.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(Laboratory.IGA AS REAL) > 80
  AND CAST(Laboratory.IGA AS REAL) < 500
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGM <= 40
   OR Laboratory.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY Patient.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Patient.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND L.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND E.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.C3 > 35
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.HCT <= 29 OR L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(E.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND L.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E
    ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(substr(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY P.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS male_patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Laboratory.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 
  AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND Laboratory.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT < 60
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
ORDER BY MAX(L.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) AS First_Recorded_Date
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT L.Date
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.LDH >= 500
  AND P."First Date" = (
        SELECT MAX(P2."First Date")
        FROM Patient AS P2
        WHERE P2.ID IN (
              SELECT DISTINCT L2.ID
              FROM Laboratory AS L2
              WHERE L2.LDH >= 500
        )
      );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' 
  AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND l.TP > 6.0
  AND l.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT E.ANA
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY L.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND E.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T3.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+'
       OR E.RVVT = '+'
       OR E.LAC = '+');

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU > 180
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GLU < 180 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'
  AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.PLT > 100 
  AND L.PLT < 400 
  AND P.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.PLT > 100
  AND T1.PLT < 400
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD';

SELECT AVG(L.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND Laboratory.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON atom.molecule_id  = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id      = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_non_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM atom
      WHERE element = 'na'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT a.atom_id, 
       a.element, 
       a2.atom_id AS atom_id2, 
       a2.element AS element2, 
       m.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a  ON c.atom_id  = a.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- One row per bond: the (unordered) pair of elements of its two atoms
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.bond_id,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_lo,
        CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS elem_hi
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds have each element combination
    SELECT elem_lo, elem_hi, COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem_lo, elem_hi
)
-- Hint: DIVIDE( count of bonds in the MAX group , total number of bonds )

WITH AllNames AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS FName, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName2 <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName3 <> ''
),
TopNames AS (
    SELECT FName, COUNT(*) AS name_count
    FROM AllNames
    GROUP BY FName
    ORDER BY name_count DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.FName, t.name_count, a.District
FROM TopNames t
JOIN AllNames a ON t.FName = a.FName
ORDER BY t.name_count DESC;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference;

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
                SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    )
    ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS Biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
                SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
                SUM(CASE WHEN y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    )
    ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC

) AS Lowest;

JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

LIMIT 1;

        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN (
    SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS losses
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
      AND home_team_goal - away_team_goal < 0
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
) L ON T.team_api_id = L.home_team_api_id
WHERE L.losses = (
    SELECT MIN(home_losses)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_losses
        FROM Match
        WHERE season = '2015/2016'
        GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    ) AS team_losses
);

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS remaining_debt,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'paid off without problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished with debt (loan not paid)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running without problems'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'running in debt'
    END AS status_meaning,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS payment_count,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', l.date)) * 12 
        + (strftime('%m', 'now') - strftime('%m', l.date)) AS scheduled_payments_by_now,
    l.duration * l.payments AS total_paid
FROM disp d
JOIN loan l 
    ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t 
    ON t.account_id = l.account_id
   AND t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
   AND t.date >= l.date

GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.amount, l.status, l.date, l.duration, l.payments;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, c.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total) AS sum_total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_total * 1.0 / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1);

WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           CustomerID,
           total_consumption,
           MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM min_totals
    WHERE total_consumption = min_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT sme.annual_average - lam.annual_average AS SME_LAM_difference,
       lam.annual_average - kam.annual_average AS LAM_KAM_difference,
       kam.annual_average - sme.annual_average AS KAM_SME_difference
FROM segment_averages AS sme
JOIN segment_averages AS lam ON lam.Segment = 'LAM'
JOIN segment_averages AS kam ON kam.Segment = 'KAM'
WHERE sme.Segment = 'SME';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

        / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l."T-BIL"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY l."T-BIL" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT T1.ID, T2."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T2."T-CHO" DESC, T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."T-CHO" >= 250

SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 50;
SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID FROM Patient AS t1 JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1.Admission = '-' AND t2.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CPK >= 250;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GLU >= 180 AND l."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT P.ID, L.GLU
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Description) AS INTEGER) = 1991
  AND L.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.WBC <= 3.5 OR T2.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY T1.SEX, T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, STRFTIME('%Y', current_timestamp) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.Admission
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) >= 50
  AND (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.HGB > 10
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 17
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Patient.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY Patient.ID
HAVING COUNT(Laboratory.ID) > 2;
SELECT AVG(T2.HCT) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date LIKE '1991%' AND T2.HCT < 29

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.PLT <= 100 OR l.PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984' AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT SUM(L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / SUM(L.PT >= 14) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(T1.Date)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND T1.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS t1
JOIN Examination AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.IGG > 900

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80 AND Laboratory.IGA < 500 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400 GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday >= '1985-1-1' AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20 AND E.Thrombosis = '0';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS t1 JOIN Examination AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1.C3 > 35 AND t2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'

SELECT `Examination`.`ID`

ORDER BY `Examination`.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) FROM Examination AS E JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2 AND L.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Patient AS t1 JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t2.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND t1.Admission = '+'

SELECT Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

FROM Patient

WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'

  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60

LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60 AND Patient.SEX = 'M'

FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.LDH >= 500

LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'

SELECT T1.Date FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5

JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-CHO" >= 250 AND T2.KCT = '-'

SELECT P.Diagnosis

LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e

WHERE e.Thrombosis = 0 AND l.CPK < 250;

SELECT MIN(T2.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T2 JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.GLU > 180
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GLU < 180 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Admission = '+' AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

FROM Patient

JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT AVG(T2.element = 'o')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.atom_id)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id)

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id

SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease
FROM (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, t.PercentageIncrease AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
              - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
              / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    ) t
    ORDER BY t.PercentageIncrease DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease
FROM (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, t.PercentageIncrease AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM (
        SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
               (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
              - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
              / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
        FROM customers c
        JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    ) t
    ORDER BY t.PercentageIncrease ASC
    LIMIT 1
);
